subject: general
question: As on 31 May 2020, who was the Chief Minister of Sikkim?
solution:
The correct answer is** __Prem Singh Tamang.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​​**Prem Singh Tamang, **often known as P. S. Golay, is an Indian politician who serves as **Sikkim's current chief minister **as well as the organization's founder and leader. He was a significant contributor to the** Sikkim Democratic Front Party** prior to the party's formation.
 
• The **All India Motorbike Expedition 2022 **was set off by the Hon. Chief Minister, **Shri Prem Singh Tamang,** in Mintokgang with the slogan,** "Tujhme Bharat Mujhme Bharat."**
 
• **Sikkim, **which is a section of the** Eastern Himalaya**, is known for its biodiversity and for having **alpine and subtropical climates.** It also contains **Kangchenjunga, the highest peak in India **and the third-highest mountain on Earth. **Sikkim's capital** and largest city is **Gangtok.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** 12th and current Chief Minister** of the State of Meghalaya is an Indian politician named Conrad Kongkal Sangma.
 
• He became the** head of the National People's Party in 2016 **following the death of his father, P. A. Sangma, a former chief minister and speaker of the **Lok Sabha.**
 
• **Neiphiu Rio****,an Indian politician,** is the ninth Chief Minister of Nagaland. Rio has served as the Chief Minister of Nagaland for three consecutive terms, making her the only person to** have done so. **
 
• **Nongthombam Biren Singh **is an Indian politician, journalist, and former football player who has been the** chief minister of Manipur **since** 2017. **
